name: Cannalicious Shatter | Blue Cookies
description: Shatter is a super smooth and ultra-refined cannabis extract that comes from cured plant material. The excess terpenes evaporate during the drying process which results in a lower terpene profile, but high cannabinoid percentage. It is produced as a flat patty with a glass-like stability and has an immediate activation time.
